name: Pia♥Carrot e Youkoso!! 3.3
original_name: Pia♥キャロットへようこそ!!3.3
source:
Main character is to spend one summer month at the newly opened store. He needs to both succeed in sales and develop encouragement atmosphere for the waitresses.
Game features uniforms of choice and guest heroines from Pia Carrot 1, 2 as well as main cast of Pia Carrot 3.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公将在新开业的门店度过一个夏月。他既要成功提高销售业绩，也要为女服务员们营造相互鼓励的氛围。
游戏可供玩家选择制服，并邀请《Pia Carrot 1》《Pia Carrot 2》的女主角与《Pia Carrot 3》的主要角色客串登场。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
